commands.voicePhrasesHint: Other ways to call it by voice (e.g. “password manager”). They count as its name; said in other words they are understood too.
editor.httpSecretHint: Saved encrypted for your Windows user (tokens, passwords). A backup restored on another PC can't read it: it has to be typed again there.
editor.httpUnreadable: The value can't be read: it was saved on another PC or by another user. Type it again.
editor.httpVariables: You can use {date}, {time} and {clipboard} in the URL and the body.
editor.httpInsecureHint: Only for services on your network with their own certificate: without the check, someone in the middle could read or change the request.
editor.waitForeground: Wait until it is in the foreground
editor.keysHint: Format: CTRL + SHIFT + N, F6, Enter, Mouse 1, Wheel Up… Press “Capture” to record it.
editor.textHint: Typed as is, any character (accents, emoji…). Line breaks press Enter.
editor.mouseHint: Screen coordinates “x,y”. “Capture position” gives you 3 seconds to place the mouse.
editor.placeMouse: Move the mouse to the desired position
editor.powerHint: Press Esc during the countdown to cancel.
editor.filterIcons: Icons and images (or a program to use its icon)
settings.themeHint: Light or dark. “System” switches along with Windows.
settings.faviconsHint: On “Open web” actions, each page's own logo instead of a generic icon. It is downloaded once from the website itself.
settings.trayImageHint: The one shown in the notification area, next to the clock. Use another one and go back to K-Desktop’s whenever you like.
settings.languageHint: Spanish, English, French, German, Italian and Portuguese are built in.
settings.translateHint: Export a template to translate it into another language.
settings.languagesInfo: Extra languages are JSON files in %APPDATA%\K-Desktop 5\Languages.
settings.languagesSteps: To make one: export the template (the English texts), translate it, save it with the language code (e.g. fr.json) and pick it under “Language”.
settings.languagesOverride: An es.json or en.json in that folder only changes the texts it contains.
settings.exportTemplateTitle: Save it with the language code (e.g. fr.json)
settings.templateError: The template could not be saved
settings.pauseHint: While paused no command runs (hotkeys, QuickMenus, K-Board, remote…). Only the open and exit hotkeys work.
settings.nav.osd.hint: Position and duration of the notices
settings.nav.android.hint: Version and APK for the phone
settings.androidNone: This build does not carry the Android app
settings.androidNoneHint: It is included when building in Release with the JDK and the Android SDK (docs\COMPILAR.md).
settings.androidUpdates: The app needs no store: this PC updates it. When a phone with an older version connects, opening the app shows a notice (tap it to update) and its Settings show «Update the app».
settings.androidInstall: Save the APK, copy it to the phone and open it. Android will ask to allow installing apps from that source, and Play Protect may warn because it does not come from the store: «Install anyway». Then type the PC address in the app and pair it with the code or QR from «Web app».
updates.mode: When there is a new version
updates.modeHint: Checked on startup and every 6 hours. “Install it by itself” downloads it and restarts K-Desktop at a moment you are not using it (window closed and nothing running); it takes a couple of seconds.
updates.urlHint: The JSON file that describes the latest version (written by tools\release\make-update.ps1). It can be http or https.
updates.notPortable: Only the portable version (a single KDesktop.exe) updates itself. This one is updated by downloading the new one.
updates.badUrl: The address is not valid (it must start with http:// or https://)
updates.noConnection: the server could not be reached
updates.timeout: the server did not answer in time
updates.badManifest: the version file is not valid
updates.badHash: The download is damaged: the SHA-256 sum does not match
updates.badFile: The downloaded file is not the announced K-Desktop version
updates.installError: The update could not be installed: {0}
updates.osdAvailable: There is a new version of K-Desktop: {0}
banner.updateMessage: You can install it now: K-Desktop restarts in a couple of seconds.
banner.updateReady: Downloaded and ready. K-Desktop restarts in a couple of seconds.
settings.startWithWindowsHint: Uses a scheduled task: starts with administrator rights without a prompt.
settings.showWindowOnStartHint: Off: K-Desktop starts in the background (tray). It is never shown when Windows starts it.
settings.trayIconHint: Always shown while the window is open. Off: with the window closed, open K-Desktop with the hotkey or by running it again.
settings.showHotkeyHint: Click and press the new combination.
settings.exitHotkeyHint: Click and press the new combination.
settings.exitSoundHint: When K-Desktop is closed with its key combination.
settings.osdSample: This is how K-Desktop messages look
settings.udpEnabledHint: Lets you run commands marked as remote by sending their name or number.
settings.udpRemoteHint: When off, only requests from this PC are accepted.
settings.webEnabledHint: Control K-Desktop from your phone or any browser: your commands, the volume and the audio output. Put HTTPS on it with a reverse proxy (Caddy).
settings.webRemoteHint: When off, only connections from this PC are accepted (the proxy would have to run here).
settings.webLocalOnly: Running for this PC only: listening on the network needs K-Desktop to run as administrator.
settings.webError: The port could not be opened. Is another program using it?
settings.webPublicUrlHint: The proxy's HTTPS address, for the QR code. Empty: the one seen coming through the proxy.
settings.webBasePathHint: Only when the app is not at the root of its domain (e.g. /kdesktop).
settings.webProxyHint: Its X-Forwarded-* headers are trusted (phone IP, HTTPS). Empty: only from this PC.
settings.webProxyOnlyHint: From the network only the proxy is accepted: devices have to come in over HTTPS.
settings.webInputHint: The web app can move the mouse, click and type on this PC.
settings.webNoDevices: None yet. The web app does nothing until a device is paired.
settings.webRevokeConfirm: Revoke "{0}"? It will have to pair again to use the web app.
settings.webNotRunning: Turn on the web server first
settings.voiceHotkeyHint: Click and press the combination (keys or mouse buttons).
settings.voiceMissing: Not installed. They are downloaded once ({0}): Parakeet, which turns speech into text (Spanish included), Silero, which detects when you speak, openWakeWord’s, which listen for the wake words, and EmbeddingGemma (Google), which understands what you mean even without the command’s exact name.
settings.voicePartial: Part of them still has to be downloaded ({0}).
settings.voiceDownloading: Downloading… {0} of {1}. You can close the window: it carries on in the background.
settings.voiceDeleteConfirm: Delete the voice models? Voice orders will not work until you download them again.
settings.voiceMicHint: It opens for each order and, with always-on listening, stays open to hear the wake words.
settings.voiceEcho: Ignore what the PC is playing
settings.voiceEchoHint: Takes music, films and any other PC sound out of the microphone (echo cancellation), so it understands you even while something plays
settings.voiceDuck: Turn the volume down while you speak
settings.voiceDuckHint: When it hears the wake word or the voice hotkey is pressed, it turns the other programs down until the order is over
settings.voiceListenSoundHint: Plays when it hears the wake word or the voice hotkey is pressed: you can say the order
settings.voiceDuckLevel: Volume they are turned down to
settings.voiceUnloadHint: Loaded, the model takes about 700 MB; loading it again takes a second and a half.
settings.voiceHowTo: Hold the hotkey while you say what to do (“open the recycle bin”), or tap it once and speak: it ends when you stop talking. Pressing it again ends sooner; Esc cancels. The command you name runs.
settings.voiceWakeSoon: With always-on listening, say the word and the order together (“KDesktop, open the browser”), or just the word and wait for “Listening…”. The microphone stays open while any word is active (it uses very little). If it ever misses it or goes off on its own, move its sensitivity.
settings.wakeWordsHint: Words you record with your voice to call K-Desktop. You can have several.
settings.wakeListenHint: Listens for the wake words without pressing anything. Pauses with K-Desktop.
settings.wakeTrust: Trust the detector when it is very sure
settings.wakeTrustHint: Answers a little sooner by skipping the Parakeet check when the detector has no doubt. It may go off now and then without the word.
settings.wakeSensitivityHint: Further right catches it more easily, but it may also go off without you saying it.
settings.wakeDeleteConfirm: Delete the wake word “{0}” and its recordings?
wake.title: Wake word
wake.nameText: What do you want to say to call K-Desktop? It learns from your voice, so it can be a made-up word such as “KDesktop”.
wake.nameTips: Best with 2 to 4 syllables and not something you say in normal conversation. You can add several, each with its own recording.
wake.silenceText: Stay quiet for 3 seconds so I can measure the background noise where you are.
wake.noise.medium: Medium background noise ({0}). Should be fine.
wake.noise.high: Quite a lot of background noise ({0}): the word will be recognised less well. If you can, turn the music off or move the mic away from the fan.
wake.wordText: Say “{0}” in your normal voice, the way you would to call K-Desktop. I’ll record it {1} times in a row (at least {2} are needed): wait for the meter to move and say it.
wake.issue.NoSpeech: I didn’t hear you. Press to continue and say it again.
wake.issue.TooShort: Too short. Press to continue and repeat it.
wake.issue.TooLong: Too long (over 2.5 s). Press to continue and repeat it.
wake.issue.TooQuiet: Very quiet: move closer to the mic or speak louder.
wake.issue.Clipped: Clipped: move a little away from the mic or lower its volume.
wake.issue.Odd: Very different from the others. Press to continue and repeat it.
wake.speechText: Now talk normally for about 10 seconds WITHOUT saying the word: read the text below or tell what you did today. This way your normal speech won’t set it off by mistake.
wake.speechSample: “This morning I checked my email, tidied a few folders on the desktop and then put on some music while I was cooking.”
wake.speechNone: I didn’t hear you speak. You can repeat it, or go on with the default threshold ({0}).
wake.speechDone: Done: the closest thing you said reached {0}; the threshold is {1}.
wake.testText: Say “{0}” (and, if you like, an order after it: “{0}, open the browser”) to see whether it is recognised. Try as many times as you like.
wake.needModels: Download the voice models first (above, in this same section).
wake.micError: The microphone could not be opened.
settings.voicePrivacy: Everything is processed on this PC; neither the audio nor the text leaves it.
settings.mediaVoice: Voice orders for music and volume
settings.mediaVoiceHint: No commands needed, in any of the installed languages
settings.mediaStepHint: How much «volume up / down» moves it (half with «a little», twice with «a lot»)
settings.musicOnHint: «Play music» opens it when it is closed and resumes it when it is paused
settings.musicOffHint: Closes the player. «Stop» or «pause» only pause it
settings.mediaExamples: Say, for example: «pause», «resume», «next song», «previous», «volume up», «a little quieter», «volume to 40 percent», «volume to max», «mute», «unmute», «play music», «close the music». They can be chained: «pause and volume down».
settings.mediaNotes: «Pause» does not start the music when nothing is playing, and «resume» does not stop it when it is. If you have a command with the same name, your command wins. Needs the voice models and the voice key or a wake word (Settings › Voice).
web.pairHint: Scan the code with the phone's camera, or open the web app and type the code. It works only once.
web.pairNoHttps: This address is not HTTPS: the app will work but cannot be installed on the home screen. Put your proxy's address in "Public address".
pwa.noCommands: No commands for the web app. Turn on “Web app” in each command.
pwa.noMenus: No QuickMenu has commands for the web app.
pwa.voice.needsHttps: Browsers only allow the microphone over HTTPS: use the proxy address or the Android app.

pwa.run.unavailable: That command is no longer available
pwa.pair.title: Pair with K-Desktop

pwa.pair.name: Name of this device
pwa.settings.unpairConfirm: Unpair this device? To use the app again you will have to pair it again.
pwa.settings.linkFailed: Could not link with the other address: pair with a new code.
pwa.appUpdate.available: A new version of the app is available
pwa.appUpdate.where: Tap here to update it (or from Settings)

pwa.installIos: To have it as an app: Share button › "Add to Home Screen".

pwa.pad.disabled: The touchpad and keyboard are turned off on the PC (Settings › Web app).
settings.disabledInHint: In these applications (games, for example) hotkeys do nothing, except commands set to always work.
settings.disabledInHotkey: Hotkey for the app in front
settings.disabledInHotkeyHint: Adds the application in front to the list, or removes it if it is there already. It also works inside them.
settings.sideButtonsHint: Stops Mouse 4 / Mouse 5 from navigating back or forward in these applications, so they can be used as hotkeys.
settings.exportHint: Export saves everything of yours to a .zip: settings, commands, QuickMenus, macros, K-Board profiles, achievements and statistics, wake words, and your own icons, sounds and languages. It leaves out the paired devices (their keys belong to this PC) and the voice models (they are downloaded again). Import replaces everything with the backup’s; the current one is saved to Backups first.
settings.exportError: The backup could not be exported
settings.importConfirm: The configuration, achievements and statistics will be replaced by the backup’s, and its icons, sounds and languages added. (The current ones are saved to the Backups folder first.)
settings.importConfirmJson: The whole current configuration will be replaced by the file’s. (The current one is saved to the Backups folder first.)
settings.importError: The file is not a valid K-Desktop backup
settings.reimportConfirm: Current commands and QuickMenus will be replaced by the K-Desktop 4 ones. (A backup of the current configuration is kept automatically.)
settings.resetAchHint: Clears the unlocked achievements and every statistic, and starts from zero. It cannot be undone.

qm.editorHint: Drag commands, items, files, folders or links onto the menu (above / into / below an item). Right click for more · Double click or F2 renames · Del removes · Alt+↑↓ moves · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo · Ctrl+C / X / V / D.

action.RunApp.name: Run application
action.RunApp.desc: Opens a program, file, shortcut or script, as the normal user or as administrator.
action.OpenFolder.name: Open folder
action.OpenFolder.desc: Opens a folder or a special Windows location.
action.OpenUrl.name: Open web page
action.OpenUrl.desc: Opens a URL in the browser of your choice.
action.AppControl.name: Control application
action.AppControl.desc: Activates, closes or waits for an application by its process name.
action.RunScript.name: Run script
action.RunScript.desc: Runs a CMD or PowerShell script written right here.
action.HttpRequest.name: Web request
action.HttpRequest.desc: Sends an HTTP request (GET, POST…) without opening the browser: Home Assistant, APIs, phone notifications…

action.Volume.desc: Sets, raises, lowers or mutes the system volume.
action.PlaySound.name: Play sound
action.PlaySound.desc: Plays a bundled sound or a .wav file.
action.TopMost.name: Always on top (on/off)
action.TopMost.desc: Pins the active window above the others, or releases it.
action.HiddenFiles.name: Hidden files (on/off)
action.HiddenFiles.desc: Shows or hides hidden files in Explorer.
action.ToggleDisabledIn.name: Disable in current app (on/off)

action.ShowMessage.name: Show message
action.ShowMessage.desc: Shows an on-screen message for a while.
action.Power.name: Power
action.Power.desc: Shuts down, restarts, sleeps, locks or signs out, with a cancellable countdown.
action.OpenQuickMenu.name: Open QuickMenu
action.OpenQuickMenu.desc: Shows a QuickMenu at the mouse position.
action.Launcher.name: Launcher
action.Launcher.desc: Opens a search box: type and press Enter to run a command, open a program or search the web.
editor.launcherHint: Type part of the name (initials or scattered letters work too: “cmfy” → ComfyUI). The most used ones come first. It also does maths: “12*3.5”.
launcher.hint: Type to search. ↑ ↓ to choose, Enter to run, Esc to close.
action.CommandControl.name: Commands
action.CommandControl.desc: Runs, enables or disables another command.
action.Wait.name: Wait
editor.macroHint: Shift + Esc stops the macro at any time (and the rest of the command). Any keys or buttons it was holding are released automatically.
action.PlayMacro.name: Play macro
action.PlayMacro.desc: Plays a recorded macro (keyboard and mouse with their timing), once or several times.
macro.emptyTitle: Record what you do and repeat it
macro.emptyText: A macro stores your keyboard and mouse input with its timing. Create one, press “Record”, do what you want to repeat and finish with Shift + Esc. Then use it from any command with the “Play macro” action.
macro.testHint: Plays the macro once after 3 seconds (Shift + Esc to stop)
macro.createCommand: Create a command that plays it
macro.deleteUsed: {0} “Play macro” action(s) use it and will stop working.
macro.gameModeHint: For games: clicks do not move the pointer, the mouse is recorded as relative movement (what games read even when they lock the pointer) and keys and clicks are held for a moment so the game sees them. Games with anti-cheat may ignore any simulated input.
macro.recordMovesHint: When off, only clicks (with their position), the wheel and the keyboard are recorded.
macro.stopHint: Shift + Esc ends the recording or stops the playback.
macro.noSteps: This macro is empty. Press “Record” or insert steps by hand.
macro.delayHint: Pause before this step, in milliseconds
macro.rawHint: Sends a relative movement like a real mouse does: that is what games and 3D programs read (pointer speed and acceleration apply). Unchecked, the pointer moves exactly that many pixels.
macro.noHooks: Hotkeys are disabled (--no-hooks): recording is not possible
macro.recordExisting: The macro already has {0} steps. Replace them with the new recording or add it at the end?

event.summary.idle: After {0} min without using the PC
event.summary.session.Suspend: When the PC goes to sleep
event.loopStopped: The event “{0}” fires too many times in a row: it stops for {1} min
event.enabledHint: On: K-Desktop watches for what sets it off
event.emptyText: An event runs commands on its own when something happens: a program opens, a time of day, a while without using the PC, locking it…
event.suspended: Stopped for a few minutes: it fired too many times in a row (a loop?)
event.testHint: Runs its commands now, without checking «Only if» or the pause
event.noCommands: It doesn't run anything yet: add one or more commands (they run in this order; drag to change it).
event.exitNote: On exit they all run at once, 5 s at most, so exiting never hangs.
event.endHint.ProcessStart: When the program closes (with several windows or processes, when the last one closes).
event.endHint.Foreground: When it stops being in front.
event.endHint.Idle: When you use the PC again.
event.conditionsHint: If they aren't met it doesn't run (the log says why). Leave empty what you don't want to use.
event.cooldownHint: If it fires again sooner, it does nothing. 0 = always. Also, an event that fires more than 10 times in a minute stops for 10 minutes.
event.deleteText: Delete “{0}”? Its commands are not deleted.
event.runIfMissed: If it was missed, run it on start
event.runIfMissedHint: If K-Desktop was closed or the PC asleep at that time, it runs as soon as it can (once, the last one missed).
event.includeRunning: Also if it was already open when K-Desktop started
event.hint.appStart: Runs every time K-Desktop starts, its commands one after another and the events in the order of the list (drag to change it). Not after an update, nor while paused.
event.hint.appExit: Runs when K-Desktop exits, when the Windows session ends or when shutting down with the Power action. Not when it restarts to update itself.
event.hint.interval: It counts from when K-Desktop starts (or from when you change the event).
event.hint.processStart: Checked every 2 seconds. With several programs, it starts when the first opens and ends when the last closes.
event.hint.foreground: When one of these programs comes to the front (with a short margin so a quick Alt+Tab doesn't count).
event.hint.idle: No keyboard or mouse in that time. What macros, K-Board or the web app touchpad type or move also counts as using the PC.
event.hint.session: When going to sleep Windows leaves very little time: use quick commands (mute, pause the music…).
enum.session.Suspend: When the PC goes to sleep
event.kind.AppStart.desc: What used to be «Run on startup» in each command.
event.kind.AppExit.desc: What used to be «Run on exit» in each command.
event.kind.Time.desc: Every day or only on some days of the week, at the time you say.
event.kind.Interval.desc: Every N minutes while K-Desktop is running.
event.kind.ProcessStart.desc: When it opens (and, in «When it ends», when it closes). For example: when Steam opens, audio output to the headphones.
event.kind.Foreground.desc: When its window comes to the front (and, in «When it ends», when it stops being there).
event.kind.Idle.desc: After some minutes without touching the keyboard or mouse (and, in «When it ends», when you come back).
event.kind.Session.desc: When the session is locked or unlocked, or the PC goes to sleep or wakes up.
event.kind.PowerSource.desc: When a laptop goes on battery or back on mains power.
event.kind.File.desc: When a file appears (created, copied, downloaded…), as soon as it stops growing. For example, a new image in the ComfyUI output folder.
event.hint.file: Filter with wildcards: *.png, render_*.mp4… (* = any). It waits until the file stops growing for a second; each file fires the event once.
event.summary.power.Mains: When it goes back on mains
enum.powerSource.Mains: When it goes back on mains
event.hint.power: Only on computers with a battery (or a UPS that tells Windows).

action.KBoard.name: K-Board
action.KBoard.desc: Turns a K-Board profile (remapped keys and buttons) on, off, or toggles it.
osd.audioNone: None of the audio devices in the list is connected
editor.audioHint: Each run switches to the next device in the list (devices that are not connected are skipped). With only one, it always switches to that one. Drag to change the order.
editor.audioSound: Test sound on the new device
kboard.listEmpty: Create a profile to remap keys and mouse buttons: Caps Lock as Ctrl, disable the Windows key in games, side buttons that copy and paste…
kboard.emptyText: K-Board changes what keys and mouse buttons do, everywhere or only in the applications you choose.
kboard.activeHint: Switches the profile on or off. It can also be done from a command or from the tray icon.
kboard.createCommand: Create a command that switches this profile on and off
kboard.deleteUsed: {0} command action(s) use it; they will no longer do anything.
kboard.appsHint: Empty = in all of them (except the ones in “Disable in”). With applications, the profile only works while one of them is in the foreground.
kboard.layerHint: Check Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win to remap combinations (e.g. Ctrl + J). Unchecked, the key itself is remapped and keeps any modifiers you hold.
kboard.captureSourceHint: Press the key, button or combination you want to remap
kboard.surfaceHint: Click a key or button to choose what it does. Remapped keys light up and show their new function; the dot means they have remaps with other modifiers.
kboard.keysHint: The key stays down while you hold the original one: it works for modifiers (Caps Lock → Ctrl) and in games. Left and right Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Win are in the list.
kboard.textHint: Typed as is, with any keyboard layout. Line breaks press Enter.
kboard.commandHint: Runs the command when the key is pressed; the key no longer reaches the application.
kboard.disableHint: The key or button does nothing while the profile is on.
kboard.normalHint: The key works normally. Choose another option to remap it.
kboard.warnClick: Careful: this profile works in every application. Changing the left or right click affects everything, K-Desktop included. If something goes wrong, switch the profile off from the tray icon.
kboard.warnSame: The key is remapped to itself: nothing changes.
kboard.noRemaps: This profile does not change any key yet.
icons.title: Choose icon
icons.searchHint: Pick a colour to paint the whole collection in that tone, or “Automatic” for each icon's own colour.

tips.title: Did you know…?
tip.w.desktop: Shows the desktop at once; press it again to bring the windows back.
tip.w.lock: Locks the PC when you step away; everything stays open as you left it.
tip.w.run: Opens the Run box: type cmd, regedit, control, %temp%…
tip.w.search: Searches apps, files and settings. Pressing Win and just typing works too.
tip.w.quicklink: Opens the quick link menu: Task Manager, Terminal, Disk Management, shut down…
tip.w.clipboard: Clipboard history: paste anything you copied earlier, not just the last thing.
tip.w.emoji: Emoji, symbol (≠ € ©…) and GIF panel in any text box.
tip.w.snip: Snips part of the screen and copies it to the clipboard.
tip.w.printscreen: Captures the whole screen and saves it in Pictures\Screenshots.
tip.w.taskview: Task view: every window and the virtual desktops.
tip.w.newdesktop: Creates a new virtual desktop and switches to it.
tip.w.switchdesktop: Switches to the previous or next virtual desktop.
tip.w.closedesktop: Closes the current virtual desktop (its windows move to the next one).
tip.w.snaplayouts: Shows the snap layouts to place the window in a grid.
tip.w.minimize: Restores a maximized window; press it again to minimize it.
tip.w.snapside: Snaps the window to the left or right half of the screen.
tip.w.monitor: Moves the window to the other screen.
tip.w.stretch: Stretches the window to the full height of the screen, keeping its width.
tip.w.shake: Minimizes everything but the active window; repeat to bring them back.
tip.w.taskbarN: Opens the app pinned at that position of the taskbar, or switches to it.
tip.w.taskbarNew: Opens another window of the app pinned at that position.
tip.w.taskbarAdmin: Opens the app pinned at that position as administrator.
tip.w.taskbarCycle: Goes through the taskbar icons with the arrows; Enter opens.
tip.w.tray: Moves the focus to the notification area (tray icons).
tip.w.notifications: Opens the notifications and the calendar.
tip.w.quicksettings: Quick settings: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, volume, brightness, airplane mode…
tip.w.project: Chooses how to use several screens: duplicate, extend or just one.
tip.w.cast: Connects to a wireless display or device.
tip.w.gamebar: Game Bar: recording, screenshots, performance and audio.
tip.w.record: Starts or stops recording the active window (Game Bar).
tip.w.dictation: Voice typing in any text box.
tip.w.language: Switches the input language or keyboard layout.
tip.w.magnifier: Magnifier: zooms the screen in and out. Win + Esc closes it.
tip.w.peek: Peeks at the desktop while you hold it.
tip.w.secure: Security screen: lock, switch user, sign out or Task Manager.
tip.w.alttab: Switches windows. With Ctrl the switcher stays open and you pick with the arrows.
tip.w.altf4: Closes the active window. On the desktop, opens the shut down dialog.
tip.w.graphics: Restarts the graphics driver: handy when the screen goes black or freezes.
tip.w.hdr: Turns HDR on or off on displays that support it.
tip.w.mute: Mutes or unmutes the microphone in supported calls.
tip.e.address: Jumps to the address bar to type a path (or cmd to open a console there).
tip.e.newwindow: Opens another window on the same folder.
tip.e.newtab: Opens a new tab in File Explorer.
tip.e.closetab: Closes the tab or the window.
tip.e.switchtab: Goes to the next or previous tab.
tip.e.rename: Renames the item; Tab moves on to rename the next one.
tip.e.properties: Opens the properties of the selected item.
tip.e.preview: Shows or hides the preview pane.
tip.e.details: Shows or hides the details pane.
tip.e.up: Goes up to the parent folder.
tip.e.back: Goes back to the previous folder or forward again.
tip.e.copypath: Copies the full path of the selected file.
tip.e.permanent: Deletes without using the Recycle Bin (careful!).
tip.e.views: Changes the view: large icons, list, details, tiles…
tip.e.zoom: Changes the icon size without any menu.
tip.e.morecontext: Opens the full classic context menu, with extras like “Copy as path”.
tip.e.expand: In the folder tree: expands every subfolder of the selected one.
tip.e.fullscreen: Makes the File Explorer window full screen.
tip.e.taskbarShift: On the taskbar: opens another window of that app.
tip.e.taskbarAdmin: On the taskbar: opens the app as administrator.
tip.e.taskbarMiddle: On the taskbar: opens another window of that app.
tip.e.taskbarCtrl: On the taskbar: cycles through the windows of the app one by one.
tip.b.reopen: Reopens the last closed tab (repeat to get more back).
tip.b.private.keys: Ctrl + Shift + N | Ctrl + Shift + P
tip.b.private: Private / incognito window (Chrome and Edge · Firefox).
tip.b.tabnum: Jumps to the tab at that position.
tip.b.address: Selects the address bar to type another address or search.
tip.b.addressnewtab: In the address bar: opens the address in a new tab.
tip.b.dotcom: In the address bar: adds www. and .com to what you typed.
tip.b.find: Finds in the page; F3 / Shift + F3 go to the next or previous match.
tip.b.hardrefresh: Reloads the page bypassing the cache.
tip.b.back: Previous or next page (same as Mouse 4 and Mouse 5).
tip.b.bookmarksbar: Shows or hides the bookmarks bar.
tip.b.print: Prints the page or saves it as PDF.
tip.b.zoom.keys: Ctrl + Wheel | Ctrl + Plus | Ctrl + Minus
tip.b.zoom: Zooms the page in or out.
tip.b.space: Scrolls down or up one screen.
tip.b.topbottom: Goes to the top or bottom of the page.
tip.b.middleclick: On a link, opens it in the background; on a tab, closes it.
tip.b.ctrlclick: Opens the link in a background tab.
tip.b.ctrlshiftclick: Opens the link in a tab and jumps to it.
tip.b.shiftclick: Opens the link in a new window.
tip.b.alttext: Selects the text of a link without opening it.
tip.b.taskmgr: Browser task manager: which tab uses the most (Chrome and Edge).
tip.t.word: Moves the cursor word by word.
tip.t.delword: Deletes the previous or next word in one go.
tip.t.line: Goes to the start or end of the line.
tip.t.selline: Selects to the start or end of the line.
tip.t.doc: Goes to the start or end of the document.
tip.t.undo: Undo or redo (in File Explorer too: undoes moving, copying or deleting files).
tip.t.clipboard.keys: Ctrl + C | Ctrl + X | Ctrl + V
tip.t.insert: Copy and paste with the classic keys (works in consoles and terminals).
tip.t.clicks: Selects the whole word or paragraph.
tip.t.paragraph: Jumps to the previous or next paragraph.
tip.t.altcode: With the numeric keypad, types characters by their code: © (0169), € (0128), ñ (0241)…
tip.k.qmleft: In the QuickMenu, runs the item and closes the menu.
tip.k.qmright: In the QuickMenu, runs the item and keeps the menu open to launch several.
tip.k.qmmiddle: In the QuickMenu, opens K-Desktop to edit the command, or the whole menu.
tip.k.qmkeys: The QuickMenu works with the keyboard; first letters jump to each item and Shift + Enter keeps it open.
tip.k.qmtoggle: Pressing the QuickMenu hotkey again closes it.
tip.k.esc: Cancels K-Desktop countdowns: shutdowns, waits and messages.
tip.k.shiftesc: Stops the macro being played and releases any keys it was holding.
tip.k.show.keys: Ctrl + Alt + Home | Ctrl + Alt + End
tip.k.show: Opens or exits K-Desktop (changeable in Settings).
tip.k.chord: Combining mouse buttons (a side button plus another button or the wheel) gives lots of extra shortcuts without the keyboard.
tip.k.kboard: With K-Board you can turn Caps Lock into Ctrl, disable the Windows key in games or make a side button copy and paste.
tip.k.disabledin: In Settings → “Disable K-Desktop in”, add your games so no hotkey gets in the way while you play.
